name: Woman's Robe
material: Silk and gold thread: embroidery on silk gauze ground; silk lining, silk batting
summary: The robe is embroidered on the back with clouds and paired phoenixes (associated with female members of the imperial family). Single phoenixes and clouds occur at the shoulders.
